en: A black-and-white image showing a snowy landscape with a traditional wooden building on the left, people sitting and drinking outdoors in winter clothing, and several pairs of skis and ski poles in the foreground. A flagpole near the center displays what appears to be the Norwegian flag, and snowy hills stretch across the background. Text printed on the bottom reads 'Gråten sæter, Sjusjøen' and 'Enerett: Håkon Prestkvern Moelv'.
